source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What is a token embedding in the pipeline studied in this course?

options.text: A text definition retrieved for each vocabulary entry.
options.feedback: An embedding is a numerical vector, not a dictionary definition retrieved as text.

options.text: A probability assigned to the next complete sentence.
options.feedback: An embedding represents a token before the output stage. Next-token probabilities are calculated after the decoder transformations.

options.text: A rule that selects which output token comes next.
options.feedback: Token selection uses the output distribution. Embeddings supply representations for the model to transform.

options.text: A numerical vector used to represent a vocabulary item.
options.feedback: A token identifier maps to a vector. The learned geometry can represent relationships between items.
